title: Sunday · Ten Years Under the Table
logline: The arc's Sunday: the walk drawn ten times, tiny, in a grid across the top tier, one for each year; the middle tier the alley now; the last the dog under the drafting table at ten, the same as at one.

panels.composition: Tier 1: ten tiny drawings of the same alley walk in a row, a man and a dog, the drawing style changing left to right.

image.prompt: a row of ten tiny watercolor drawings of the same man and dog walking the same alley, the style changing subtly left to right, no words

panels.name: Ten

panels.composition: Tier 2: the alley behind the Lanes tonight, the sign lit, the two of them from behind.

image.prompt: a man and a dog from behind in a rainy alley under a lit bowling alley sign, watercolor

panels.name: Now

panels.composition: Tier 3: the dog asleep under the drafting table in the garage, the lamp on, a hand hanging down to him.

image.prompt: a dog asleep under a drafting table in a garage with a lamp on and a man's hand hanging down to it, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Under
